text.autoconfig.optional_pickup.title: Optional Pickup
text.autoconfig.optional_pickup.option.o: X position (0 = right edge, 100 = left edge)
The item list Y render offset
text.autoconfig.optional_pickup.option.t: Enter item IDs, such as minecraft:enchanted_book or mod_id:item_id. Listed items show their additional tooltip first, falling back to their name if no detail is available. Other items show their name. Clear the list to disable tooltip priority.
